hide_on_scroll: Hide translations while the page scrolls, show them when it stops (easier on the eyes)
skip_names: Skip names and one-word labels (e.g. Bill Gates, Premium)
disk_cache: Remember translations on this computer, so the same text is not sent again (plain text; turning this off deletes them)
speech_enable: Translate speech: list what is heard at the bottom of the screen
auto_proper: Auto-detect proper nouns (Capitalized / ALL CAPS / CamelCase)
keep_katakana: Japanese: keep ALL katakana untranslated (also loanwords like タワー)
glossary_placeholder:
Never translate these (one per line)
e.g. Hatsune Miku
NVIDIA
google_enable: Use Google Translate first (sends the text to Google; the offline engine is the backup)
start_on_launch: Start translating as soon as the app opens
status_google_limited: Running (Google is refusing requests from this computer for now: using offline)
status_google_unreachable: Running (cannot reach Google: offline for now)
no_ocr: No OCR language packs installed in Windows
packs_text:
Translating this pair offline needs: {names}
Each pack is a one-time download of about 50-100 MB. How do you want to get it?
update_text:
Screen Translator {version} is available (you have {current}).
Download and install it now? The app restarts by itself when it is done.
up_to_date: Screen Translator is up to date
speech_model_text: Speech translation needs the "{name}" speech model (about {mb} MB, downloaded once, then everything runs offline). How do you want to get it?
pick_model_folder: Pick a faster-whisper model folder (contains model.bin)
tray_still_running: It stays in the system tray. Right-click its icon to open the settings or quit.
close_action: When the window's X is pressed
close_tray: Keep running in the system tray
close_text: Keep it running in the background (system tray), or quit everything? You can change this later in Settings > General.
problem_title: Text was read but not translated
problem_packs: The offline language pack ({detail}) is missing and Google is off. Download the pack, or turn Google on. Settings > General > Test translation shows details.
problem_refused: Google is refusing requests from this computer for now, and there is no offline pack to fall back on. Download the offline pack, or wait. Settings > General > Test translation shows details.
problem_network: Cannot reach Google (check the internet) and there is no offline pack to fall back on. {detail} Settings > General > Test translation shows details.
problem_offline: The offline translation engine failed: {detail} Settings > General > Test translation shows details.
problem_other: No translation came back. {detail} Settings > General > Test translation shows details.
diagnose_button: Test translation (shows what works and what does not)
speech_no_translation: Heard, but there is no translation: {err}
